title: Built specifically for the way labour consultancies operate.
description: LabourFlow is not a generic HRMS or payroll tool. It is designed around the multi-client workflow, statutory requirements and daily operations of Indian labour law consultancies.

items.title: Consultant-First
items.description: Built for labour law consultants managing compliance for multiple client companies — not for a single company's internal HR team.

items.title: Multi-Client by Design
items.description: Manage your entire client portfolio from one workspace, switch between clients quickly and keep each company's data, compliance and documents organized.

items.title: Deep Indian Compliance
items.description: Designed around Indian labour compliance including PF, ESI, PT, minimum wages, factory licences and other statutory requirements.

items.title: Government-Ready Workflows
items.description: Generate compliance outputs such as ECR files, ESI challans and PT returns in workflows designed around Indian government filing requirements.

items.title: Automation Built In
items.description: Automate recurring reminders, document expiry alerts, attendance requests, client communication and other repetitive consultancy work.

items.title: AI-Ready Platform
items.description: Designed to support AI-powered notice reading, compliance queries, document classification, risk alerts and proactive compliance assistance.

items.title: Designed to Scale
items.description: Move from spreadsheets and disconnected tools to a structured platform that supports growing client portfolios, teams and multi-branch operations.

items.title: Affordable for Growing Consultancies
items.description: Built for growing consultancy practices with a flat subscription approach rather than increasing costs with every client you add.
